relationships.subject: Mepyramine
relationships.evidence_quote: Here we show that mepyramine directly inhibits a variety of voltage-gated sodium channels, including the Tetrodotoxin-sensitive isoforms and the main isoforms (Nav1.7, Nav1.8, and Nav1.9) of nociceptors.

relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, mepyramine inhibited the firing responses of C- and Aβ-type nerve fibers in ex vivo skin-nerve preparations.

key_findings: Mepyramine directly blocks Nav1.7, Nav1.8, Nav1.9 and TTX-sensitive sodium channels with state-dependent preference.
Topical mepyramine produced analgesia in acute, inflammatory and chronic pain models.
